name: roofs_house_b
prompt:
Image 1 is the finished sheet; image 2 is its layout: 9 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 3×3 grid. Redraw only cells 1 and 7 (the transparent areas). Keep every other cell exactly as it is, and match their style, colours and fine detail.

The faults in those two cells: each roof stops a few px short of the outline's thick bottom edge, leaving a thin gap of background along the street front; cell 1 also drew its roof about 7% too shallow, with the ridge well above the middle. Each roof now fills its outline in image 2 exactly, edge to edge, its bottom edge on the outline's thick bottom edge, the ridge along the middle of the depth, the two slopes equal. The porch is a small lean-to roof drawn INSIDE the outline along the middle of the bottom edge, about a fifth of the roof's depth.

For each redrawn cell, trace the outline in image 2 exactly, keep its proportions, straight square edges, top-down with no perspective, and keep the magenta background flat pure #FF00FF outside it. Details at true size: small cottages next to cars 4 m long; a brick chimney is a small square about 0.6 m across, roof courses fine and closely spaced. No text.

1. 9.8 × 6.3 m (1.6× wider than deep) — small single-storey cottage, gabled roof of dark grey bitumen shingles, one brick chimney, a lean-to porch on the street side
7. 11.2 × 4.2 m (2.7× wider than deep, a thin strip) — small single-storey cottage, gabled roof of brown metal tiles, one brick chimney, a lean-to porch on the street side
